cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: I Know the Procedure
cards.instruction: Perform investigative confidence while quietly using each response to discover what the questions, clues, and next steps should be.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. As building manager, I'll establish why this door won't lock. Describe the anomaly. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The hinge is loose. I usually tighten it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Precisely. Show me your usual method so I can assess it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll need the screwdriver from your desk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, we've reached the tool stage. Which drawer do you normally find it in?

responseLogic.evidence: B2 hinge diagnosis and B4 screwdriver need are coherent; A5 ignorance of own-desk drawer exposes dependence without contradicting B knowledge.

relationship.evidence: B2 offers an actual usual repair and B4 names its needed tool.

heightening.evidence: B4 tool clue becomes A5 the proclaimed next stage and a revealing location question.
